motions.item_title: Affordable Housing Policy Program – Vacant Home Tax By-Law, 2026-302
motions.name: First Motion
motions.text: That staff be directed to finalize the proposed Vacant Home Tax By-law, as described in the Affordable Housing Policy Program – Vacant Home Tax By-law report, dated June 10 th , 2026 . That staff be directed to implement the Vacant Home Tax By-law once approved and to report back annually. That any revenues in excess of expenses from the Vacant Home Tax be directed to the Affordable Housing Reserve (119) annually.
motions.text_html:
1. That staff be directed to finalize the proposed Vacant Home Tax By-law, as described in the Affordable Housing Policy Program – Vacant Home Tax By-law report, dated June 10th, 2026.
  2. That staff be directed to implement the Vacant Home Tax By-law once approved and to report back annually.
  3. That any revenues in excess of expenses from the Vacant Home Tax be directed to the Affordable Housing Reserve (119) annually.

motions.item_title: Affordable Housing Policy Program – Vacant Home Tax By-Law, 2026-302
motions.name: Second Motion
motions.text: That staff be directed to review Property Standards and Yard Maintenance fines and propose increases in line with other municipal comparators with a view to improving compliance. And that staff be directed to review the administration fees related to the Property Standards and Yard Maintenance By-laws for repeat violations.
motions.text_html:
1. That staff be directed to review Property Standards and Yard Maintenance fines and propose increases in line with other municipal comparators with a view to improving compliance.
  2. And that staff be directed to review the administration fees related to the Property Standards and Yard Maintenance By-laws for repeat violations.

motions.item_title: Affordable Housing Policy Program – Draft Rental Renovation Bylaw, 2026-241
motions.text: That staff be directed to finalize the proposed Rental Renovation By-law establishing a licencing framework for renovations requiring vacant possession, as described in the Affordable Housing Policy Program – Draft Rental Renovation By-law Report, dated June 10, 2026. That implementation of the Rental Renovation By-law will begin in 2026 with implementation costs being funded through the Affordable Housing Reserve (119), and the annualized costs of $374,000 being included as a base budget adjustment in the Operating Budget through the 2027 Budget Update. That staff be directed to implement the bylaw using existing municipal enforcement tools and report back annually. That staff be directed to monitor and assess the implications of Bill 97 and report back to Council at a later date on its impacts, including operational, financial, or policy considerations for the City.
motions.text_html:
1. That staff be directed to finalize the proposed Rental Renovation By-law establishing a licencing framework for renovations requiring vacant possession, as described in the Affordable Housing Policy Program – Draft Rental Renovation By-law Report, dated June 10, 2026.
  2. That implementation of the Rental Renovation By-law will begin in 2026 with implementation costs being funded through the Affordable Housing Reserve (119), and the annualized costs of $374,000 being included as a base budget adjustment in the Operating Budget through the 2027 Budget Update.
  3. That staff be directed to implement the bylaw using existing municipal enforcement tools and report back annually.
  4. That staff be directed to monitor and assess the implications of Bill 97 and report back to Council at a later date on its impacts, including operational, financial, or policy considerations for the City.

motions.item_title: Affordable Housing Policy Program - Recommended Policy Direction for a Rental Replacement By-law, 2026-292
motions.text: That staff be directed to finalize the proposed Rental Replacement By-law, as described in the Affordable Housing Policy Program – Recommended Policy Direction for a Rental Replacement By-law, dated June 10 th , 2026. That staff be directed to present an Official Plan Amendment and Demolition control By-law amendment for Council approval in July 2026 to enable the implementation of the Rental Replacement By-law. That implementation of a Rental Replacement By-law will begin in 2026 with implementation costs being funded through the Affordable Housing Reserve (119), and the annualized costs of $193,000 be included as a base budget adjustment in the Operating Budget through the 2027 Budget Update.
motions.text_html:
1. That staff be directed to finalize the proposed Rental Replacement By-law, as described in the Affordable Housing Policy Program – Recommended Policy Direction for a Rental Replacement By-law, dated June 10th, 2026.
  2. That staff be directed to present an Official Plan Amendment and Demolition control By-law amendment for Council approval in July 2026 to enable the implementation of the Rental Replacement By-law.
  3. That implementation of a Rental Replacement By-law will begin in 2026 with implementation costs being funded through the Affordable Housing Reserve (119), and the annualized costs of $193,000 be included as a base budget adjustment in the Operating Budget through the 2027 Budget Update.

motions.text: That by-law (2026) - 21268 be approved subject to Section 284.11 (4) of the Municipal Act.
motions.text_html: 1. That by-law (2026) - 21268 be approved subject to Section 284.11 (4) of the Municipal Act.
